answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on merkle tree inclusion proofs coupled with sequential time-delay beacons. Written in a analytical prose structured with explicit logical operators and causality register, it stays short. A haven of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ferrous of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The meadow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
